prompt:
A row of SIX separate ABILITY UPGRADE MODULE sprites for a 2D Metroidvania, evenly spaced with WIDE EMPTY BLACK GAPS between them, each complete and uncropped, all the same size, all centred on a shared horizontal line.

Each module is a floating cybernetic artifact that fuses HARDWARE with SHINTO RELIC — a data-shrine object. Each has a distinct silhouette and colour so it is instantly identifiable, and each glows from within.

1. PING SWEEP (dash) — a flat circular disc like a radar plate, with three concentric expanding rings etched into it, glowing cyan #35C6F4. A small shimenawa rope wraps its rim.
2. PRIVILEGE ESCALATION (double jump) — an upward-pointing angular chevron stack, three chevrons rising and getting smaller, glowing acid green #C6F02A, mounted in a small dark metal frame with rivets.
3. PACKET INJECTION (ranged attack) — a sharp forward-facing dart or lance shape inside a hexagonal housing, glowing hot magenta #FF2D95, with small vent slots along its sides.
4. TUNNEL (phase through walls) — a hollow torus / ring with its centre fully empty and transparent, the ring itself deep violet #B026FF with a pale cyan inner rim, small paper ofuda talisman strips hanging from it.
5. INTEGRITY MODULE (max health up) — a rounded armoured capsule split by a vertical seam, glowing warm amber #FFD400 through the seam, with a small red #E01F26 oni-mask emblem stamped on its face.
6. SOUL CAPACITY MODULE — a faceted crystal vial containing a bright green #C6F02A spirit flame, bound in dark metal bands with a small cyan readout dot.

Every module reads as a PICKUP: compact, symmetrical, obviously an object of value, with a strong lit core.

PIXEL ART: chunky visible square pixels on a strict grid, hard aliased edges, a 1-pixel dark outline on every shape, flat cel shading, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur. Cyberpunk: Edgerunners aesthetic — saturated neon against deep shadow, bold flat colour blocking.

BACKGROUND: PURE BLACK #000000 everywhere. NO grid lines, NO borders, NO labels, NO text, NO watermark.

PALETTE: #000000 #0A0E1F #1E33D9 #2B6FE8 #35C6F4 #00E5FF #8FE8FF #B026FF #FF2D95 #FF6B1A #FFD400 #8F1116 #E01F26 #C6F02A #6B8A0F #FFFFFF #4A5568.

A row of FOUR separate PEDESTAL sprites for a 2D game, evenly spaced with WIDE EMPTY BLACK GAPS between them, each complete and uncropped, all standing on a shared ground line. These are the plinths an ability upgrade floats above.

Style: weathered stone shrine base fused with cyberpunk server hardware — an altar that is also a machine.

1. IDLE PEDESTAL: a squat tapered stone plinth, grey #4A5568 with dark seams and chipped edges, a small torii-shaped bracket on its front face, and a dim cyan #35C6F4 ring inlaid in its top surface. Thin cables run from its base.
2. ACTIVE PEDESTAL: the same plinth with the top ring blazing bright cyan, light spilling up from it, and small green #C6F02A spirit motes rising.
3. SPENT PEDESTAL: the same plinth gone dark and dead — the ring unlit and cracked, a wisp of faint smoke, cables slack.
4. A TALLER VARIANT: the same design but a two-tier stepped plinth with a stone fox-spirit statue seated on one corner, ring lit cyan.

All four the same width and aligned so they can be swapped frame to frame.
